bullets.text: Chelsea Stadium Gets Upgrade - **Virgin Media O2** enhances mobile infrastructure at Stamford Bridge for better fan connectivity.
AI for Energy Savings - Telecoms explore AI to optimize energy use amid rising consumption and sustainability pressures.
Ericsson Job Cuts - **Ericsson** announces 1,600 job cuts in Sweden to improve competitiveness amid financial challenges.
Longer Spectrum Rights - EU proposals may grant telecom operators longer access to radio spectrum, aiding network planning.
NTT DATA's Marine Cable - **NTT DATA** leads a consortium to build a $1 billion submarine cable enhancing Asia's connectivity.
AI-RAN Delivers ROI - **AI-RAN** technology shows promise in energy efficiency and operational savings for telecoms.
Brady's Labelling Solutions - **Brady** updates mobile labelling printers to improve telecom network maintenance efficiency.
FWA Growth Momentum - Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) revenues projected to grow as operators manage spectrum carefully.
